name: Book The Move
description: Done-for-you outbound for moving & storage companies. It finds homeowners in the client's area who have just listed their homes, verifies contact info, and sends personalized emails on the mover's behalf to book jobs. Growth $397 / Pro $697 / Scale $1,197 per month. Founded Jan 2025, US. Listed for sale at $375,000 (6.1x; first listed Apr 1, 2026; 16 offers per TrustMRR).

mentions.evidence: ~$5,125 MRR, 5 active subscriptions, ~$5,125 L30, ~$144,134 all-time, ~80% L30 profit margin, L30 MRR growth −8.9%. Revenue synced Oct 6, 2026 ~04:50 Warsaw (02:50 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: "Trigger event → local service pro" outreach: new listings → movers / cleaners / handymen, new company registrations (KRS/CEIDG) → accountants, building permits → kitchen/window installers. A $400–$1,200 monthly retainer per territory.

whyItPrints: Public listing data turned into a trigger list (a listed house means a move is coming) for one blue-collar vertical with a high job value. 5 clients at ~$1k/mo average (my calculation) and an 80% margin.
whyThisMatters:
A moving company claims its counties on Book the Move, and those counties stay locked to that company. Each day the service finds houses that were just listed, checks the owner's contact, and emails from the mover's name. A reply lands in the mover's inbox.

Growth is 25 emails a day, in up to three counties. Pro is 50 a day and adds a sequence for realtors. Scale is 100 a day, with no county cap, a named manager, and a monthly call. No contract, and they say a campaign can be live within a day.

They say replies come back above 6 percent. The company started in January 2025.
